blurb: Black Lab Brewing offers a bottle shop, tap room, and front patio open daily until 9pm. They have a beer garden open Friday 3-9pm and Saturday & Sunday noon-9pm. Their beers include varieties like Wheeler Helles Lager with Coffee and Pup Lite Golden Ale.
